title: ROOM 5 -- TALK TO WINNIE: dialogue approach, opening and emphasis (Tyler's manual playthrough, 2026-09-04)

staging.rootCause: TALK TO on an ambient person walks Thad to a conversational gap beside them AT THEIR BASELINE (GameScene: from = npc.x +/- 0.66 x zone height; walkTo(from, npc.y)). Winnie's baseline is y401, the row under her hands, behind the counter; the walk snapped to the nearest floor point, the counter's base line y700, so he stood pressed against the desk over her ledger. The gap was also computed from the zone table (222 x 0.66 = 147) rather than the room's curve.
staging.mechanism: content/ambient/winnie.json declares walkTo {x:930, y:760, facing:'back'} -- an ambient's own dialogue point, read by GameScene in place of the computed gap; he turns to face her on arrival as before. The room's depth model is unchanged: 512 px at y760 is the declared curve (470 at y700 -> 560 at y830). Thad's scale unchanged.
staging.why: C4 (965,760) covers her hands and the ledger; C1 (930,750) leaves 60 px of floor and reads as nearly at the counter; C3 (930,778) reads a touch far for a clerk and a customer; C2 keeps clear floor between his feet and the counter, his body left of the page so her hands stay in view, facing her. Judged on the live frames (renders/room-05-dialogue-approach-candidates.png), not the numbers.

WIN_A1's options, responses, flags and later nodes are unchanged. WIN_A2's exit line 'Mind the window.' stays: the window is a room fact (WINDOW (AJAR) hotspot), not a dependency on the removed exchange.
